items.title: Computer science
items.description: Computer science is the study of computation, information, and automation. ... Included broadly in the sciences, computer science spans theoretical disciplines ( ...
highlighted: the study of computation, information, and automation

items.markdown:
Computer science is `the systematic study of computation, information processing, and the design of both software and hardware systems`.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUQHrOzAVaHItOsZ2z37LkPtJH5Pt70k9PyMuxZAl-Bz6MGX-NX3bmO7M-UyTQnTXm6jR3SLsMVanbpDn-q4Dnv2bzyxm4seRBkZlxzKUATRuPA) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUQHrOzAVaHItOsZ2z37LkPtJH5Pt70k9PyMuxZAl-Bz6MGX-NX3bmO7M-UyTQnTXm6jR3SLsMVanbpDn-q4Dnv2bzyxm4seRBkZlxzKUATRuPA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESPwHrOzAVgg_6Fn8UuFHgEGJQrWHzv7p063BY3n3_gbswJqJosXseVzY6xeAMe3M8JpDWYH8-4Q1_akvbynZpYw)

Core Concepts

- **Algorithms:** Step-by-step instructions and logical rules used to solve complex problems and manipulate data efficiently.
- **Programming Languages:** Artificial languages like Python, C++, or Java that let humans write instructions that a computer can translate and execute.
- **Systems and Architecture:** The study of how computer hardware, operating system kernels, and memory interact to run applications.
- **Theory of Computation:** The mathematical exploration of what computers can fundamentally compute and their inherent limitations.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVPrmYdY8ZmSgeFXl2j-HrdBkQ6WJpUopUSKCL8EfZrNhZI_mLT89BXsWy6LVR7RlM2Su2hQluj4hj07T3mBcN_7jbymVg5-BrZg) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVPrmYdY8ZmSgeFXl2j-HrdBkQ6WJpUopUSKCL8EfZrNhZI_mLT89BXsWy6LVR7RlM2Su2hQluj4hj07T3mBcN_7jbymVg5-BrZg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVf63PxKFrT9_9Mu09MRrjtkj9fqnGVMLuW42hO4eRuaRn-E-PL1ueApoHl-f1tUnaDrKmpS11jiddRMYhjjbdjk8mfUftxOe-zmbguXVQSr9HUm0AGU5kZvzt7w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUgHrOzAVrz2n3i4MhYlW6Zh50lbj6hF49jDObjsWhfZRbeHrC_LaxHGbxYRWKep8g1EeYq78oX0Q5RTcRd2Td3MP-JRjSXEU26THk_OcXQVd3wc)

Major Specializations

- **Artificial Intelligence (AI):** Building systems that perform tasks requiring human-like reasoning, learning, and pattern recognition.
- **Software Engineering:** The disciplined creation, testing, and maintenance of large-scale software applications.
- **Cybersecurity:** Protecting networks, computers, and private data from digital attacks, theft, or unauthorized access.
- **Data Science:** Collecting, storing, and analyzing massive data sets to uncover actionable insights.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVATgGUBWTzvadKOtF438FbPmc8YIdce1tkdQebu_ubAI8PLoEJbxVIyVQh8H2maJUbVKsk6fn6jUPalS2PRG0Z_eFwfQFF_E9YS_FBghA) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVATgGUBWTzvadKOtF438FbPmc8YIdce1tkdQebu_ubAI8PLoEJbxVIyVQh8H2maJUbVKsk6fn6jUPalS2PRG0Z_eFwfQFF_E9YS_FBghA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVf63PxKFrT9_9Mu09MRrjtkj9fqnGVMLuW42hO4eRuaRn-E-PL1ueApoHl-f1tUnaDrKmpS11jiddRMYhjjbdjk8mfUftxOe-zmbguXVQSr9HUm0AGU5kZvzt7w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAV0bDqCxcKdiIbHnk3nDWq5Y-uEFHQpFRBdA_2uXs1aSwAWH3LRV3g0uOasHdoy2nJWLlVQDv_N_cMGN6BsWenoa-8yceh_hg5jw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESPwHrOzAVgg_6Fn8UuFHgEGJQrWHzv7p063BY3n3_gbswJqJosXseVzY6xeAMe3M8JpDWYH8-4Q1_akvbynZpYw)
